content.title: What channel is Thunder vs Nuggets on TV tonight? Time, NBA schedule, injury report
content.text: Updated April 10, 2026, 6:19 p.m. CTThe OKC Thunder will face the Denver Nuggets on the road at 8 p.m. CT Friday.OKC (64-16) clinched the top seed in the Western Conference with a 128-110 road win over the Los Angeles Clippers on Wednesday. The Thunder has ruled out 10 players for Friday's game as a result including its star trio of Shai Gilgeous-Alexander, Jalen Williams and Chet Holmgren.Denver (52-28) secured a 136-119 home win over the Memphis Grizzlies on Wednesday. Nikola Jokic, Jamal Murray and Aaron Gordon are listed as questionable.Here's everything you need to know about Friday's game between the Thunder and Nuggets:Order our new book on Thunder's run to NBA titleWhat time is Thunder vs Nuggets game tonight?Date: Friday, April 10Time: 8 p.m. CTWhere: Ball Arena in DenverWatch Thunder vs Nuggets live on FuboWhat channel is OKC Thunder vs Denver Nuggets on tonight?TV: FanDuel Sports NetworkHow to watch online: Fubo (free trial)Thunder vs Nuggets predictions, picksJustin Martinez: Denver 117, OKC 105OKC has already clinched the top seed in the West, and it has ruled out 10 players for Friday's game as a result. That leaves the Thunder with eight guys available, and three of them are on two-way contracts. This should be a very winnable game for the Nuggets, who are still trying to clinch the third seed.Thunder vs Nuggets betting oddsOdds via BetMGM as of Friday, April 10Odds: Denver by 11.5Over/under: 232.5Moneyline: OKC +375 | Denver -500Thunder vs Nuggets injury updatesThunder: Alex Caruso (rest) is out. Shai Gilgeous-Alexander (right oblique injury management) is out. Isaiah Hartenstein (left soleus injury management) is out. Chet Holmgren (low back spasms) is out. Isaiah Joe (left knee soreness) is out. Ajay Mitchell (left ankle injury management) is out. Thomas Sorber (right ACL surgical recovery) is out. Cason Wallace (left great toe soreness) is out. Jalen Williams (right hamstring injury management) is out. Jaylin Williams (right Achilles tendinitis) is out.Nuggets: Aaron Gordon (right hamstring injury management) is questionable. Nikola Jokic (right wrist injury management) is questionable. Spencer Jones (right hamstring strain) is out. Jamal Murray (right shoulder impingement) is questionable.
